Root Cause: The volume mount {{ base_path }}/minicontrol{{ server_num }}:/minicontrol/userdata was overlaying the entire userdata directory, including plugins/. When the Docker image put plugins in /minicontrol/userdata/plugins/kacky/, they were hidden by stale local files from a previous deployment method that used git clone.

Solution: Move plugins to /minicontrol/core/plugins/kacky/ instead. MiniControl loads plugins from both ./core/plugins and ./userdata/plugins, so this works. The userdata mount now only affects database, logs, and settings - not plugins.
